answer.answerText:
**No—an as-of-right determination for this specific property cannot be made from the supplied facts.** The proposed use is listed as Use Group IX(A) “Self-service storage facility” with the symbol **♦P** in M1, M2 and M3 districts: ♦ means permitted with limitations and P means additional conditions. (ZR § 42-191.) But no address/BBL or controlling official map evidence establishes whether this lot is in a Manufacturing District, a special district affecting the site, or an Appendix J designated area/subarea.

If the lot is in an Appendix J **Subarea 1**, the use is subject to the stated as-of-right provisions but must be limited to an establishment providing industrial floor space or the specified “business-sized” storage space. If it is in **Subarea 2**, it requires a City Planning Commission special permit under ZR § 74-192, not as-of-right approval. (ZR § 42-192; Appendix J.) The P notation also makes the use subject to the performance standards in ZR §§ 42-40 through 42-48. (ZR § 42-193.) A facility that existed on December 19, 2017 may follow separate conforming/enlargement rules only if the stated DOB documentation and other conditions are met; without satisfactory DOB documentation, it is non-conforming and subject to Article V. A documented facility that is damaged or destroyed may be reconstructed on the same zoning lot, subject to the ZR § 43-10 floor-area limit. (ZR § 42-192.) None of those historical branches can be applied to this unidentified property.

(ZR § 42-191.) But no address/BBL or controlling official map evidence establishes whether this lot is in a Manufacturing District, a special district affecting the site, or an Appendix J designated area/subarea.

supportedPoints.heading: General Manufacturing District allowance is conditional
supportedPoints.explanation: The Use Group IX(A) table marks “Self-service storage facility” ♦P in M1, M2 and M3 districts. Under the table legend, ♦ means “Permitted with limitations” and P means “Additional conditions”; it is not an unqualified general as-of-right allowance.

supportedPoints.heading: Appendix J subarea controls the designated-area path
supportedPoints.explanation: Within a designated Manufacturing District area shown in Appendix J, Subarea 1 is subject to the stated as-of-right provisions and is limited to facilities providing industrial floor space or specified business-sized storage. In Subarea 2, a self-service storage facility requires a City Planning Commission special permit under ZR § 74-192. Appendix J identifies designated areas and distinguishes Subareas 1 and 2; it does not establish this property's location in either subarea.

supportedPoints.heading: Additional condition applies to the P notation
supportedPoints.explanation: For uses marked P in ZR § 42-191, other than the listed boat-storage and public-parking exceptions, ZR § 42-193 requires conformity with the performance standards in ZR §§ 42-40 through 42-48. The self-service-storage row is marked P.

supportedPoints.heading: Subarea 2 is a special-permit route
supportedPoints.explanation: For zoning lots in Appendix J Subarea 2 designated Manufacturing District areas, ZR § 74-192 authorizes the City Planning Commission to permit development, certain enlargements, or change of use for a Use Group IX(A) self-service storage facility upon the required finding regarding suitability of the zoning lot and surrounding land-use characteristics. This is not an as-of-right path.

supportedPoints.heading: Appendix J supplies the mapped subarea framework
supportedPoints.explanation: Appendix J states that its maps show designated Manufacturing District areas, with Subarea 1 for the ZR § 42-19 as-of-right provisions and Subarea 2 for the ZR § 74-192 City Planning Commission special permit. The supplied text lists designated areas and map numbers but does not locate the unidentified property on a map.

supportedPoints.heading: Existing-facility alternatives depend on dated status and documentation
supportedPoints.explanation: A facility existing on December 19, 2017 in an Appendix J designated area is conforming only if satisfactory documentation of its existence and its qualifying definition was filed with DOB. An enlargement or extension of that documented conforming facility is relieved of the stated industrial-floor-space, business-sized-storage, or special-permit requirement only if there is no increase in the zoning-lot area from that date. A documented building that is damaged or destroyed may be reconstructed on the same zoning lot and continue as self-service storage, but its floor area cannot exceed the amount permitted by ZR § 43-10. A facility existing on that date without satisfactory DOB documentation is non-conforming and subject to Article V.

citations.title: Use Group IX – uses permitted with limited applicability

supportingPassages.selectedText:
For uses denoted with “♦” in Section 42-191 (Use Group IX – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply.

In designated areas within Manufacturing Districts, as shown on the maps in APPENDIX J (Designated Areas Within Manufacturing Districts) of this Resolution, a self-service storage facility is subject to the provisions of this Section. Designated areas in which self-service storage facilities are subject to the as-of-right provisions of this paragraph are shown on the maps in Subarea 1, and those in which such uses are subject to special permit of the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 74-192 (Self-service storage facility in designated areas within Manufacturing Districts) are shown on the maps in Subarea 2. A self-service storage facility shall, in Subarea 1 of APPENDIX J of this Resolution, be limited to establishments that provide an industrial floor space as defined in Section 12-10 (DEFINITIONS) or “business-sized” storage space as specified in paragraph (b)(2)(ii) of this Section.

A self-service storage facility shall, in Subarea 2 of APPENDIX J of this Resolution, be permitted by special permit of the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 74-192 (Self-service storage facility in designated areas within Manufacturing Districts). Any self-service storage facility existing on December 19, 2017, located in a designated area within Manufacturing Districts, as shown on the maps in APPENDIX J, shall be considered a conforming use, provided that the owner of such self-service storage facility has filed documentation satisfactory to the Department of Buildings that it existed on such date and met the definition of self-service storage facility set forth in Section 12-10. Any enlargement or extension to an existing conforming facility need not provide industrial floor space, business-sized storage, or apply for special permit of the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 74-192, as applicable, provided there is no increase in lot area of the zoning lot as it existed on December 19, 2017. In the event that a building for which satisfactory documentation has been filed with the Department of Buildings is damaged or destroyed by any means, such building may be reconstructed on the same zoning lot and continue as a self-service storage facility without providing industrial floor space or business-sized storage, as applicable, provided that the floor area of such reconstructed self-service storage facility does not exceed the floor area permitted pursuant to the provisions of Section 43-10 (FLOOR AREA REGULATIONS), inclusive. Any self-service storage facility existing on December 19, 2017, that does not file such documentation satisfactory to the Department of Buildings pursuant to the provisions of this Section shall be considered non-conforming and subject to the provisions of Article V (NON-CONFORMING USES AND NON-COMPLYING BUILDINGS) of this Resolution.

citations.relevance: Establishes Subarea 1 and Subarea 2 treatment and the dated existing-facility, documentation, enlargement, reconstruction, and nonconforming-use branches.

sources.title: Use Group IX – uses permitted with limited applicability
sources.text:
For uses denoted with “♦” in Section 42-191 (Use Group IX – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply.

In designated areas within Manufacturing Districts, as shown on the maps in APPENDIX J (Designated Areas Within Manufacturing Districts) of this Resolution, a self-service storage facility is subject to the provisions of this Section. Designated areas in which self-service storage facilities are subject to the as-of-right provisions of this paragraph are shown on the maps in Subarea 1, and those in which such uses are subject to special permit of the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 74-192 (Self-service storage facility in designated areas within Manufacturing Districts) are shown on the maps in Subarea 2. A self-service storage facility shall, in Subarea 1 of APPENDIX J of this Resolution, be limited to establishments that provide an industrial floor space as defined in Section 12-10 (DEFINITIONS) or “business-sized” storage space as specified in paragraph (b)(2)(ii) of this Section.

A self-service storage facility shall, in Subarea 2 of APPENDIX J of this Resolution, be permitted by special permit of the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 74-192 (Self-service storage facility in designated areas within Manufacturing Districts). Any self-service storage facility existing on December 19, 2017, located in a designated area within Manufacturing Districts, as shown on the maps in APPENDIX J, shall be considered a conforming use, provided that the owner of such self-service storage facility has filed documentation satisfactory to the Department of Buildings that it existed on such date and met the definition of self-service storage facility set forth in Section 12-10. Any enlargement or extension to an existing conforming facility need not provide industrial floor space, business-sized storage, or apply for special permit of the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 74-192, as applicable, provided there is no increase in lot area of the zoning lot as it existed on December 19, 2017. In the event that a building for which satisfactory documentation has been filed with the Department of Buildings is damaged or destroyed by any means, such building may be reconstructed on the same zoning lot and continue as a self-service storage facility without providing industrial floor space or business-sized storage, as applicable, provided that the floor area of such reconstructed self-service storage facility does not exceed the floor area permitted pursuant to the provisions of Section 43-10 (FLOOR AREA REGULATIONS), inclusive. Any self-service storage facility existing on December 19, 2017, that does not file such documentation satisfactory to the Department of Buildings pursuant to the provisions of this Section shall be considered non-conforming and subject to the provisions of Article V (NON-CONFORMING USES AND NON-COMPLYING BUILDINGS) of this Resolution.

sources.text: 42-193 Use Group IX – uses subject to additional conditions For uses denoted with a “P” in Section 42-191 (Use Group IX – general use allowances), the following provisions shall apply: Boat storage shall be restricted to boats less than 100 feet in length. Public parking garages and public parking lots shall be subject to the provisions set forth in Section 44-025 (Applicability of regulations to public parking garages and public parking lots). All uses denoted with a “P” in Section 42-191 (Use Group IX – general use allowances), except boat storage, public parking garages and public parking lots, shall conform to the performance standards set forth in Sections 42-40 (PERFORMANCE STANDARDS) through 42-48 (Performance Standards Regulating Humidity, Heat or Glare), inclusive.

sources.text: 74-192 Self-service storage facility in designated areas within Manufacturing Districts On zoning lots in designated areas within Manufacturing Districts in Subarea 2, as shown on the maps in Appendix J (Designated Areas Within Manufacturing Districts) of this Resolution, the City Planning Commission may permit the development, enlargement not permitted pursuant to the provisions of Section 42-193 (Use Group IX – uses subject to additional conditions), or change of use of a building for self-service storage facility use listed under Use Group IX(A).
